objective: Inventory legacy stock-trading-system assets for the historical Top30 research project.
prompt:
Read the canonical Stock Research Lab documents first.

SOURCE REPOSITORY
https://github.com/ansu-peter-lim/stock-trading-system

TARGET REPOSITORY
stock-research-lab

OBJECTIVE
Perform a research-oriented inventory of the legacy repository and determine
which existing assets should support the three-year historical Top30 study.

DO NOT migrate, modify, copy, commit, or push code in this job.

Inspect at minimum:

- src/telegram_top30_parser
- telegram_collect_3years.py
- src/research_universe
- src/backtest_engine
- src/kiwoom_daily
- src/kiwoom_rest
- src/krx_openapi
- src/stock_mapping
- relevant tests
- docs/research
- existing token-efficiency work

For each meaningful component classify it as:

REUSE
  Suitable largely as-is.

ADAPT
  Valuable but requires modification for the new point-in-time Top30 research architecture.

REFERENCE
  Preserve its ideas/results but do not migrate the implementation initially.

DEFER
  Not required for the current historical Top30 research stage.

For every REUSE or ADAPT candidate identify:
- purpose
- important files
- dependencies
- relevant tests
- data/API assumptions
- credentials/external-service assumptions
- point-in-time / look-ahead risks
- recommended migration order

Pay special attention to:
1. reconstructing approximately three years of historical Top30 records;
2. stock-code/name mapping through historical corporate events;
3. daily OHLCV/history acquisition;
4. research-universe eligibility at historical cutoff dates;
5. reusable technical indicators/backtest infrastructure;
6. existing research knowledge worth preserving;
7. code or architecture that would unnecessarily increase complexity/token usage.

Produce a concise inventory report under:
docs/migration/

The report must include:
- component classification matrix;
- dependency map;
- recommended minimal migration slice;
- explicit deferred components;
- known risks/unknowns;
- proposed next migration job.

Do not implement the migration.

Run only inspection/read operations.
Do not alter the legacy repository.

Final response:
summarize findings, report location, limitations, and recommended next job.
